Professional Services · AppScan 360° — GitLab CI/CD integration · Python edition

AppScan GitLab CI/CD Integration for SAST, DAST & SCA

runtime Python 3.9 – 3.14 · requests · pwsh 7.2+ or bash on Windows runner self-hosted Linux or Windows · reaches AppScan 360° + target api /api/v4 (AppScan 360° 2.2.0) use as include: remote: $APPSCAN_TEMPLATES_URL/yaml/appscan360_scan_sast.yaml document Integration reference · prepared by Professional Services · September 2026

1 · How it works

At job start the runner clones the integration scripts from a central repository, authenticates to AppScan 360°, finds or creates the application, submits the scan (SAST source archive or IRX, SCA manifest, or DAST configuration), waits for the result, downloads reports, publishes findings to GitLab's security widget and applies a security gate that passes or fails the job.

template · appscan360_scan_sast

SAST

Static analysis of the checked-out source. Upload the source tree as an archive (nothing to install on the runner) or generate an IRX with SAClientUtil on the runner.

template · appscan360_scan_sca

SCA

Open-source composition from the package manifests, a container image, a running container or an SPDX SBOM. Adds license report, SBOM export and a license gate.

template · appscan360_scan_dast / _dast_api

DAST

Dynamic scan of a web application (URL, credentials or recorded login, recorded traffic), an API (Postman, OpenAPI, recorded traffic) or an AppScan Standard .scan/.scant file. Private targets through an AppScan Presence.

stepsEach job runs four commands in sequence: app → sast | sca | dast → report → gate. They share application id, scan id and execution id through .appscan360-state.json in the job workspace.

Components

One job, in sequence

three template sets · same content, different include

About the examples. Host names, IP addresses, repository paths, tags and runner tags shown in this document (appscan360.example.com, gitlab.example.com, 192.0.2.10, security/appscan360-gitlab, v1, appscan) are placeholders marked example. Replace them with your own values; wherever a value is written as $VARIABLE it is read from a CI/CD variable and needs no editing.

folderwhenproject include
yaml/Central repository readable without authentication (public GitHub project, public/internal GitLab project). Template fetched with include: remote:.$APPSCAN_TEMPLATES_URL/yaml/appscan360_scan_sast.yamle.g. https://gitlab.example.com/security/appscan360-gitlab/-/raw/v1

Keeping the scripts on the runner

Instead of cloning on every job, copy the package to one of the folders below. With the default APPSCAN_SCRIPTS_SOURCE: auto the template finds it and skips the clone — no variable changes needed. These folders are outside the job workspace, so GitLab's per-job cleanup (git clean, which removes everything under builds/) never touches them.

runnerfolders searched, in ordercontents
Linux$APPSCAN_SCRIPTS_DIR (if set) · /opt/appscan360 · ~/appscan360 of the runner userappscan360.py · as360/ · requirements.txt
Windows$APPSCAN_SCRIPTS_DIR (if set) · C:\appscan360 · C:\GitLab-Runner\appscan360 · %ProgramData%\appscan360 · %USERPROFILE%\appscan360 of the service accountsame files; read permission for the service account

Folder layout on the runner

By default the integration scripts are cloned to as360_worker_scripts directly under the runner's builds directory — outside the project checkout, so they are never part of the scanned source and need no runner configuration. The project itself stays at GitLab's default checkout path. Relocating the checkout as well (GIT_CLONE_PATH) is optional and requires [runners.custom_build_dir] enabled = true in the runner's config.toml.

# template default (appscan360_base*.yaml)
variables:
  APPSCAN_SCRIPTS_CLONE_DIR: $CI_BUILDS_DIR/as360_worker_scripts     # "" = per-job temp folder

# optional, only if the runner allows custom build directories
  GIT_CLONE_PATH: $CI_BUILDS_DIR/repo_source_code/$CI_PROJECT_NAME
updatesA pre-installed copy is not updated by moving the tag — replace the folder when a new version is released, or delete it to fall back to cloning.
job tokenWith the same-instance option the central project must allow the callers: central project → Settings → CI/CD → Job token permissions → add the consuming group. Sharing a domain does not remove this step — the job token is scoped to the running project.
private githubA private GitHub repository can host the scripts (token in the clone URL) but not the templates: GitLab's include: remote: cannot authenticate to raw.githubusercontent.com.
movingBecause no repository URL is hard-coded in the templates, moving the central repository later means changing these variables only.

variablesruledefine in
APPSCAN_TEMPLATES_*Used inside include:. Includes are evaluated before jobs, so these must come from Settings → CI/CD → Variables (group, instance or project) or be written literally in the include line.Settings only

Managing the variables

GitLab CI/CD variables are inherited top-down: instance → group → subgroup → project → pipeline file → job. Define each value at the highest level where it is the same for everyone and override only where a project differs.

levelput herehow
group (or instance)Everything shared by all projects: APPSCAN_SERVICE_URL, APPSCAN_KEY, APPSCAN_SECRET, APPSCAN_TEMPLATES_*, APPSCAN_SCRIPTS_GIT_URL / _REF, APPSCAN_RUNNER_TAG, default gates and report formats.Group → Settings → CI/CD → Variables
projectWhat is specific to one application: APPSCAN_APP_ID or APPSCAN_APP_NAME, DAST_URL, DAST_LOGIN_*, gate thresholds that differ from the group default.Project → Settings → CI/CD → Variablesor the project's .gitlab-ci.yml variables: for non-secrets
jobPer-job differences inside one pipeline, e.g. a stricter gate for the DAST job only.appscan360-dast: variables:
flagsMasked for every secret (hidden in job logs; needs ≥ 8 characters, no spaces). Protected only if scans run solely on protected branches — a protected variable is not available to feature-branch pipelines and the job then fails with an empty key. Keep Expand variable reference on for values containing ${CI_JOB_TOKEN} or $APPSCAN_TEMPLATES_TOKEN.
file variablesStore a CA bundle as a File-type variable: GitLab writes it to a temporary path and the variable holds that path, so APPSCAN_CA_BUNDLE can point straight at it.
environment scopesUse the variable's Environment scope to keep one name with different values, e.g. DAST_URL for staging and production, and set environment: on the job.
rotationTo rotate the API key: generate a new key pair in the AppScan 360° portal, update APPSCAN_KEY/APPSCAN_SECRET once at group level, then revoke the old key. To adopt a new version of the integration: move the v1 tag, or change APPSCAN_SCRIPTS_GIT_REF and APPSCAN_TEMPLATES_REF.
verifyThe first line the job prints after the clone — AppScan 360° host: … app: … scan: … gates: … — shows the resolved values without secrets. CI_DEBUG_TRACE: "true" dumps every variable, masked ones included; use it only on a private test project.
symptomRemote file `/yaml/…` does not have a valid address means APPSCAN_TEMPLATES_URL was placed in the pipeline file's variables: block, where it is empty at include time.

6 · SAST

template · appscan360_scan_sast.yaml
SAST_UPLOAD_MODE: zip · default

Source archive

The runner zips the source tree and uploads it (fileType=SourceCodeArchive); AppScan 360° prepares it. Needs only Python. Limits: 2 GB, ASCII names, no .NET assemblies/.sln/.gem; Java archives are analysed as bytecode unless appscan-config.xml at the root sets sourceCodeOnly="true".

SAST_UPLOAD_MODE: irx

IRX on the runner

SAClientUtil is downloaded from your AppScan 360° server, prepare builds the IRX, the IRX is uploaded. Needed for .NET, scan speed, secrets, third-party and latest-commit options. Requires a JDK/Maven for Java or MSBuild for .NET Framework (Windows runner).

SAST_UPLOAD_MODE: auto

Auto

IRX if SAClientUtil is present or downloadable, otherwise archive.

variablepurposevalues / default
SAST_ZIP_EXCLUDEoptionalGlob patterns left out of the archive. Excluded automatically: .git, .gitlab/, .gitlab-ci.yml, node_modules and the integration's own folders. In IRX mode the same list is written as <Exclude> entries in the generated appscan-config.xml."docs/*,*.log,vendor/*"default
SAST_CONFIG_FILEoptionalappscan-config.xml: IRX mode passes it with -c; archive mode honours a copy at the repository root.pathdefault
SAST_SOURCE_CODE_ONLYoptional-sco: skip binaries and Java bytecode.yes · nodefault no
SAST_LATEST_COMMIT_ONLYoptionalScan only files changed in the last commit (IRX; needs GIT_DEPTH ≥ 2).yes · nodefault no
SAST_INCLUDE_SCAoptionalInclude open-source findings in the same SAST scan (one scan, one report). For licenses, SBOM and image sources use the SCA template instead.yes · nodefault no
SAST_SECRETSoptionalSecrets detection.enable · disable · onlydefault
SAST_SCAN_SPEEDoptionalIRX analysis depth.simple · balanced · deep · thoroughdefault
SAST_THIRD_PARTYoptional-t: include third-party code.yes · nodefault no
SAST_JDK_PATHoptionalJDK used by SAClientUtil for Java projects.pathdefault
client versionappscan.sh update is never run: the SAClientUtil build belongs to the AppScan 360° installation. Re-download after a server upgrade by deleting the local SAClientUtil folder.

8 · DAST

templates · appscan360_scan_dast.yaml · appscan360_scan_dast_api.yaml
DAST_MODE: web · default

Web application

Starting URL, additional domains, excluded/included paths, login (none, credentials, recorded), HTTP auth, TOTP, recorded traffic and multi-step files, test policy and tuning.

DAST_MODE: api

API

Postman collection (+ environment, globals, linked files), OpenAPI definition (file or URL, base URL, API keys) or recorded API traffic. Domains to test are added as additional domains.

DAST_MODE: file

AppScan Standard file

Upload a .scan (configuration + login + explore data) or .scant template. TestOperation selects a full scan, test-only (Retest), continue, or result import.

11 · Runner requirements

Linux shell · Linux Docker · Windows

About the examples. Host names, IP addresses, repository paths, tags and runner tags shown in this document (appscan360.example.com, gitlab.example.com, 192.0.2.10, security/appscan360-gitlab, v1, appscan) are placeholders marked example. Replace them with your own values; wherever a value is written as $VARIABLE it is read from a CI/CD variable and needs no editing.

The runner must reach GitLab (or GitHub, for the clone) and the AppScan 360° server. Disable instance/shared runners for the project or tag the runner and set APPSCAN_RUNNER_TAG; a GitLab.com shared runner cannot reach an internal AppScan 360°.

Linux · shell executor

sudo apt-get install -y python3 python3-requests git unzip curl      # add openjdk-17-jdk maven for Java IRX mode
curl -L "https://packages.gitlab.com/install/repositories/runner/gitlab-runner/script.deb.sh" | sudo bash
sudo apt-get install gitlab-runner
sudo gitlab-runner register --url https://gitlab.example.com --token glrt-… --executor shell --tag-list appscan --non-interactive
sudo rm -f /home/gitlab-runner/.bash_logout                         # avoids "prepare environment: exit status 1"
echo "192.0.2.10 appscan360.example.com" | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts    # only if the server is not in DNS (example values)

Linux · Docker executor

Jobs use image: python:3.12-slim; the template installs git and unzip in the container. Containers need DNS and a route to the server — in /etc/gitlab-runner/config.toml:

[runners.docker]
  dns = ["192.0.2.53"]                                   # example: your DNS server
  extra_hosts = ["appscan360.example.com:192.0.2.10"]    # example: server not in DNS
placementDo not install Docker on the AppScan 360° Kubernetes node itself; Docker changes iptables and can interfere with the cluster network.

Windows · shell executor (PowerShell)

Python 3 and Git for Windows on the PATH of the account the runner service runs as. Include the *_windows.yaml templates: same variables and behaviour, PowerShell before_script. The Python code detects the operating system itself (Windows SAClientUtil, appscan.bat, win_x64 Presence). Required for .NET Framework SAST.

.\gitlab-runner.exe register --url https://gitlab.example.com --token glrt-… --executor shell --shell pwsh --tag-list appscan-win --non-interactive
python --version; git --version        # both must succeed from a non-interactive shell
python not foundThe runner service runs under its own account (often SYSTEM or a dedicated service user) with its own PATH, so a Python installed "for the current user" is invisible to jobs. Symptoms: python : The term 'python' is not recognized, or the Microsoft Store alias opening instead of Python. Fix: install Python for all users with "Add python.exe to PATH" ticked (winget install Python.Python.3.12 --scope machine), turn off the App execution aliases for python.exe/python3.exe in Windows Settings, then Restart-Service gitlab-runner. The template also accepts the py launcher. Last resort: extend the service PATH in config.toml → [[runners]] environment = ["PATH=C:\\Python312;C:\\Python312\\Scripts;%PATH%"].
symptomParserError: Missing '(' after 'if' followed by Job succeeded means a Linux template ran on a PowerShell runner. Switch the include to the _windows template; its script raises on every failure.

Manual test on the runner (no pipeline)

Run the integration by hand on the runner to validate connectivity, credentials and the runner setup before wiring a pipeline. Any failure here reproduces exactly in the job. Values are session-only and nothing is written to disk except the job state file.

windowsPowerShell, opened as the account the runner service uses.
# get the scripts once (example URL and token placeholder)
git clone --branch v1 https://oauth2:<token>@gitlab.example.com/security/appscan360-gitlab.git C:\appscan360
python -m pip install requests

# connection – replace the example values with yours; the key pair comes from the AppScan 360° portal
$env:APPSCAN_SERVICE_URL          = "https://appscan360.example.com"
$env:APPSCAN_KEY                  = "<api key id>"
$env:APPSCAN_SECRET               = "<api key secret>"
$env:APPSCAN_ACCEPT_UNTRUSTED_SSL = "yes"
$env:APPSCAN_APP_ID               = "<existing application id>"   # or omit and use --app-name / --asset-group-id with the app step

# DAST smoke test against an example target
cd C:\appscan360
python appscan360.py dast --url https://app.example.com --wait
python appscan360.py report --formats html
python appscan360.py gate severity --sev-sec-gw highIssues --max-issues-allowed 0

# SAST from a checked-out project
cd C:\path\to\source
python C:\appscan360\appscan360.py app  --app-name MyApp --asset-group-id "Web Applications"
python C:\appscan360\appscan360.py sast --upload-mode zip --wait
linuxSame commands with export VAR=value instead of $env:VAR = … and python3; clone to ~/appscan360.
expectedAuthentication successful → Using existing application … → DAST scan created → Scan status: Running … Ready → Issues: …. Each step also writes .appscan360-state.json so report and gate find the scan automatically.

Python dependencies

One third-party package: requests (brings urllib3, certifi, idna, charset_normalizer). Python 3.9 or newer. The template installs it when import requests fails and pip is available.

# Linux                            # Windows (as the runner account)
sudo apt-get install -y python3-requests           python -m pip install requests

# Offline Windows server: download on a connected machine with the same Python major.minor, then install from the folder
python -m pip download requests --dest wheels --only-binary=:all: --platform win_amd64 --python-version 3.12 --implementation cp
python -m pip install --no-index --find-links C:\wheels requests
python -m pip install C:\wheels\charset_normalizer-3.4.2-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl   # single file; order: certifi, idna, urllib3, charset_normalizer, requests

12 · Reference pipelines

examples · replace placeholder values

About the examples. Host names, IP addresses, repository paths, tags and runner tags shown in this document (appscan360.example.com, gitlab.example.com, 192.0.2.10, security/appscan360-gitlab, v1, appscan) are placeholders marked example. Replace them with your own values; wherever a value is written as $VARIABLE it is read from a CI/CD variable and needs no editing.

Minimal — Linux runner, central repository readable, SAST

include:
  - remote: '$APPSCAN_TEMPLATES_URL/yaml/appscan360_scan_sast.yaml'   # APPSCAN_TEMPLATES_URL, secrets, clone URL: group variables
# nothing else: the application is created automatically under the project name

Values in the pipeline file — private project, DAST with credentials

include:
  - remote: 'https://gitlab.example.com/security/appscan360-gitlab/-/raw/v1/yaml/appscan360_scan_dast.yaml'   # example URL

variables:
  APPSCAN_SCRIPTS_GIT_URL: "https://gitlab-ci-token:${CI_JOB_TOKEN}@gitlab.example.com/security/appscan360-gitlab.git"   # example
  APPSCAN_SCRIPTS_GIT_REF: "v1"
  APPSCAN_RUNNER_TAG: "appscan"                       # example runner tag
  APPSCAN_SERVICE_URL: "https://appscan360.example.com"   # example host
  APPSCAN_KEY: "$APPSCAN_KEY"                         # masked CI/CD variables
  APPSCAN_SECRET: "$APPSCAN_SECRET"
  APPSCAN_APP_ID: "$APPSCAN_APP_ID"                   # existing application, never created
  APPSCAN_ACCEPT_UNTRUSTED_SSL: "yes"
  DAST_URL: "https://app.example.com"                 # example target
  DAST_LOGIN_METHOD: "userpass"
  DAST_LOGIN_USER: "scanuser"
  DAST_LOGIN_PASSWORD: "$DAST_LOGIN_PASSWORD"
  APPSCAN_GATES: "threshold"
  APPSCAN_FAILURE_THRESHOLD: "High"                   # fail on any High or Critical

Windows runner — private central repository in the same GitLab, SAST for .NET

include:
  - project: 'security/appscan360-gitlab'             # example project path
    ref: 'v1'
    file: 'yaml-gitlab-private/appscan360_scan_sast_windows.yaml'

variables:
  APPSCAN_SCRIPTS_GIT_URL: "https://gitlab-ci-token:${CI_JOB_TOKEN}@gitlab.example.com/security/appscan360-gitlab.git"   # example
  APPSCAN_SCRIPTS_GIT_REF: "v1"
  APPSCAN_RUNNER_TAG: "appscan-win"                   # example
  APPSCAN_SERVICE_URL: "https://appscan360.example.com"   # example
  APPSCAN_APP_NAME: $CI_PROJECT_NAME
  APPSCAN_ASSET: "Web Applications"                   # example asset group name; empty = default group
  SAST_UPLOAD_MODE: "irx"                             # .NET Framework needs an IRX generated on Windows

SAST and SCA in parallel, then DAST through an ephemeral Presence

include:
  - remote: '$APPSCAN_TEMPLATES_URL/yaml/appscan360_scan_sast.yaml'
  - remote: '$APPSCAN_TEMPLATES_URL/yaml/appscan360_scan_sca.yaml'
  - remote: '$APPSCAN_TEMPLATES_URL/yaml/appscan360_scan_dast.yaml'

appscan360-sca:
  variables:
    SCA_SOURCE: "image"
    SCA_IMAGE: "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA"
    APPSCAN_GATES: "severity,license"

appscan360-dast:
  services:
    - name: "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA"
      alias: app
  variables:
    DAST_URL: "http://app:8080"                       # reachable only from the runner
    DAST_EPHEMERAL_PRESENCE: "yes"

API scan — OpenAPI with an API key

include:
  - remote: '$APPSCAN_TEMPLATES_URL/yaml/appscan360_scan_dast_api.yaml'
variables:
  DAST_API_METHOD: "openapi"
  DAST_OPENAPI_FILE: "openapi.yaml"
  DAST_API_BASE_URL: "https://api.example.com"        # example
  DAST_API_DOMAINS: "api.example.com"                 # example
  DAST_API_KEYS: "$DAST_API_KEYS"                     # masked: "X-Api-Key=…"

Compliance framework — no project file at all

GitLab Premium/Ultimate: point the group's compliance-framework pipeline configuration at examples/compliance-framework.yml in the central project; every project the framework is applied to runs the scans without touching its own .gitlab-ci.yml.

13 · Troubleshooting

symptom → cause → fix
symptomcausefix
Remote file `…` could not be fetched (404)Include URL wrong, tag not moved, or repository private (include:remote cannot authenticate).Open the raw URL in a browser; move the tag; for private repositories use the same-instance or remote-private template set.
Remote file `/yaml/…` does not have a valid addressAPPSCAN_TEMPLATES_URL defined in the pipeline file's variables: block.Define it in Settings → CI/CD → Variables, or write the URL literally in the include line.
did not find expected key while parsing a block mappingYAML indentation (variables: not under the job) or tab characters.Two spaces; keep variables: aligned with extends: and stage:.
setting GIT_CLONE_PATH is not allowed, enable `custom_build_dir` featureGIT_CLONE_PATH was set (optional checkout relocation) without the runner's permission.Remove GIT_CLONE_PATH, or enable [runners.custom_build_dir] in config.toml and restart the runner.
This job is stuck … no runners onlineRunner tagged while the job is untagged, or runner offline.Set APPSCAN_RUNNER_TAG or allow untagged jobs; gitlab-runner restart / verify.
Job runs on a GitLab.com shared runnerInstance runners enabled for the project.Settings → CI/CD → Runners → disable instance runners, or tag the job.
Could not resolve host … Timeout while contacting DNS servers (Docker executor)Job containers cannot reach the host's DNS.dns = […] and extra_hosts = […] in config.toml, or use the shell executor.
prepare environment: exit status 1 (Linux shell executor)gitlab-runner user's bash profile exits (.bash_logout runs clear).rm /home/gitlab-runner/.bash_logout
repository '$APPSCAN_SCRIPTS_GIT_URL' does not existClone URL / ref variables not defined.Set APPSCAN_SCRIPTS_GIT_URL and APPSCAN_SCRIPTS_GIT_REF.
remote: HTTP Basic: Access denied (clone)Private central repository without token, or job token not allow-listed.Use gitlab-ci-token:${CI_JOB_TOKEN}@… and add the consuming group under Job token permissions in the central project.
ParserError … Job succeeded (Windows)Linux template on a PowerShell runner.Include the *_windows.yaml template.
python.exe : … NativeCommandError at & $py -c "import requests" (Windows)Windows PowerShell 5.1 treats redirected stderr of a native command as a terminating error under $ErrorActionPreference = Stop; requests was not installed.Install requests on the runner (python -m pip install requests) and use the current Windows template, which relaxes the preference around native calls. Optionally set shell = "pwsh" in config.toml for PowerShell 7.
jre/bin/java: Permission deniedSAClientUtil extracted by an earlier version without executable bits.Delete the SAClientUtil folder in the runner user's home; the current version restores permissions.
Scan pod ContainerCreating: calico … connection is unauthorized (server side)Stale CNI credentials on the AppScan 360° Kubernetes node, typically after a suspend/resume or certificate rotation.kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart daemonset rke2-canal; delete the stuck scan pod. Not caused by the runner.
Application … does not exist and no asset group id was givenAutomatic creation without asset group and no default group.Set APPSCAN_ASSET (id or name) or APPSCAN_APP_ID; appscan360.py assets lists groups.
Scan status: Failed / Timed out after N minutesScan error on the server or timeout too low.Check the scan in the portal; raise APPSCAN_TIMEOUT_MINUTES.
Security Gate build FAILEDIssues above the configured limit.Adjust the gate, use threshold, or APPSCAN_GATE_ALLOW_FAILURE: yes while tuning.
healthy logFetching AppScan 360° scripts … Authentication successful … Using existing application / Created application … scan created … Scan status: Running … Ready … Issues: critical=0 high=… … Report saved … GitLab report written … Security Gate passed … Job succeeded

14 · Command line & API surface

appscan360.py · /api/v4

Every job step is a sub-command of appscan360.py; each option has a variable of the same meaning (--help shows the mapping), so the CLI can be run by hand on a runner to reproduce a job.

commandpurpose
appfind/create the application or verify --app-id
assetslist asset groups
sastSAST scan (--upload-mode zip|irx|auto and all SAST options)
scaSCA scan (--sca-source source|image|container|sbom)
dastDAST scan (--dast-mode web|api|file and all DAST options)
report--formats html,pdf,xml,csv,sarif,json,gitlab,license,sbom
gateseverity | threshold | branch | compliance | license; exit 2 on failure
presencelist | create | delete AppScan Presences
irxgenerate an IRX only, no upload
python3 appscan360.py app  --app-name MyApp --asset-group-id "Web Applications"
python3 appscan360.py sast --upload-mode irx --scan-speed thorough --secrets enable
python3 appscan360.py dast --url https://app.example.com --login-method recorded --login-file login.dast.config   # example target
python3 appscan360.py report --formats html,sarif,gitlab
python3 appscan360.py gate severity compliance --sev-sec-gw highIssues --max-issues-allowed 0

REST endpoints used (AppScan 360° 2.2.0, API v4)

endpointuse
POST /api/v4/Account/ApiKeyLogin · GET /Account/Logoutlogin (or X-Api-Key header)
GET /api/v4/AssetGroups · GET/POST /api/v4/Appsasset groups; find or create the application
POST /api/v4/FileUpload?fileType=…SourceCodeArchive, DastPostmanCollectionJson/Zip, DastOpenAPIFile, SbomSpdx; none for .irx/.config/.scan
POST /api/v4/Scans/Sast | Sca | Dastcreate scan
GET /api/v4/Scans/{tech}/{id} · POST /Scans/{id}/Executionsstatus and counts; rescan
POST /api/v4/Reports/Security/Scan/{id} · GET /Reports · GET /Reports/{id}/Downloadreports
POST /api/v4/Reports/License/Scan/{id} · POST /Reports/Sbom/{executionId}SCA license report, SBOM
GET /api/v4/Issues/Scan/{id}issues → GitLab security report
GET /api/v4/OsLibraries/GetLicForScope | GetLibrariesForScope/ScanExecution/{id}license gate
GET/POST/DELETE /api/v4/Presences · GET /Presences/{id}/Download/{platform}ephemeral Presence (win_x64 · linux_x64 · osx_x64)
GET /api/v4/Tools/SAClientUtilByType?toolType=Win|Linux|MacSAClientUtil download from your server
